name: English
start: Hi, I'm Sapa, the new-hire check-in assistant. Please use the invite link from HR to join.
invalidInvite: This invite link can't be used. Please ask HR for a new link.
managerLinked: Linked. Sapa will message you here when HR assigns an action to you.
typeInstead: Sapa can't handle voice notes, pictures or files yet. Please type your message instead.
consent: Sapa asks you a few short questions during your first six months. Taking part is voluntary. You choose who can read your answers, and you can type STOP at any time to end everything. Do you agree to take part?
declined: No problem. You won't get any more messages from Sapa.
visibilityPrompt: Thank you. Who may read your answers? HR only is the default.
visibilitySaved: Saved. You can change this later with /privacy.
stopped: You have stopped. Sapa will not send you any more messages.
help: You can type /help, /stop, or STOP at any time. Sapa will message you for your next check-in.

ask.name: ask
ask.description: Ask a question about the company

privacy.name: privacy
privacy.description: See who can read your answers

qa.askPrompt: Type your question after /ask, or just type it here.
qa.label: AI answer
qa.unknown: I don't know yet. I have logged your question for HR, without your name.
qa.important: This is an important matter, so I will not answer it. Please speak to HR directly:

checkin.intro: Hi, it's time for your Sapa check-in. It takes about a minute. Tap an answer, or type when asked.
checkin.reminder: A gentle reminder: your Sapa check-in is still open. Pick up where you left off, or ignore this and it will close.
checkin.thanks: Thank you, your answers are saved.

questions.text: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week? (1–5)
How supported do you feel by your manager this week? (1–5)
How much do you feel part of the team this week? (1–5)
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week? (1–5)
How manageable is your workload this week? (1–5)
Is there anything about your first weeks that you would like HR to know? Please type your answer.

checkin.gotIt: Got it. Your answer is saved and HR will look at it.

probes.text: Could you tell me a bit more about that?
Which tasks or priorities are unclear to you right now?
What support would you like from your manager?
What would help you feel more part of the team?
Which part of your workload is hardest to manage?

offer.text: HR would like to help with what you shared. Would you like a short private chat?
offer.accepted: Thank you. HR will contact you within 2 working days.
offer.declined: No problem. Thank you for telling us.

nudges.7: Day 7 for {name}: Book a 15-minute priorities chat.

closure: HR has finished looking into what you shared. If you want to talk to HR again, you can reach them here:

safety.message:
Thank you for telling us. This is serious, so it goes to HR only. Your manager cannot see it. HR will contact you within 1 working day. If you are in danger now, call 999.
You can also reach:
safety.forcedLabour:
Thank you for telling us. Nobody may keep your passport or ID, make you pay a debt or fee to keep your job, or stop you from leaving where you live. This goes to HR only. Your manager cannot see it. HR will contact you within 1 working day.
You can also reach:
safety.labourAuthority: Labour Department (Jabatan Tenaga Kerja): [SLOT: contact, verified before launch]
safety.tribunal: Tribunal for Anti-Sexual Harassment: [SLOT: contact, verified before launch]

forced_labour_indicator: not allowed to leave the hostel

exitPrompt: If you resign one day, may HR ask you one short question about why?
end: Your check-ins have ended. Your answers are kept until {date}. Type DELETE to remove them now.

exit.question: One last question, if you are willing: what was the main reason you left?
exit.open: Is there anything you want to add? Please type it.
exit.thanks: Thank you. Sapa will not message you again.
